# Nine examples with both Neo themes ignore the catalog's ?theme=

## Context

The Portal's example cards open each example with `?theme=` set to the Portal's current theme (#21835). Nine covered examples configure both Neo themes and still ignore the request. Vega found them. Measured again on `dev` at `5a338859ee`: headless Chromium, each example loaded with a Neo Dark request, a Neo Light request and none, reading the theme class on `<body>`:

| Example | Opens on, with either request or none |
|---|---|
| `scheduler/meridian`, `dashboard/desk`, `dashboard/choreography`, `layout/sideBySide`, `tab/browser` | `neo-theme-neo-dark` |
| `component/markdown`, `list/animate`, `component/graphScene`, `charts` | `neo-theme-neo-light` |

A visitor from the light Portal lands on a dark Meridian Observatory or dock desk. A visitor from the dark Portal lands on a light Markdown or amCharts page.

## The Problem

None of the nine starts through `resolveStartTheme`, so the request never reaches the main view, and each opens on `themes[0]` of its `neo-config.json`. #21951 (PR #21953) wires 15 examples that lack the requested Neo theme. These nine have both, so they need only the wiring.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/util/Theme.mjs` `resolveStartTheme(Neo.config)`: an exact match for the request wins, then Neo Dark when the browser prefers dark, then `themes[0]`. 35 `app.mjs` files on `dev` pass it as their main view's `theme`, for example `examples/board/basic/app.mjs`.
- Each of the nine roots is a `Neo.container.Viewport`. `Viewport#syncBodyTheme` mirrors a root viewport's theme onto `document.body`.
- Each one's only theme control is `Neo.button.ThemeSwitcher`. It reads the viewport's effective theme on boot (`activeTheme`), so it starts in step with a requested theme. None has a toggle of its own, unlike the six in #21973.

Design authority: #21835, "An example opens on the theme of the catalog that launched it".

## The Fix

In each `app.mjs`, give the main view `theme: resolveStartTheme(Neo.config)`. The nine examples are `scheduler/meridian`, `dashboard/desk`, `dashboard/choreography`, `layout/sideBySide`, `tab/browser`, `component/markdown`, `list/animate`, `component/graphScene` and `charts`, all under `examples/`.

Without a request, the nine then follow the resolver as its other callers do. In a browser that prefers dark, that changes the four light-first examples: `dev` opens them in Neo Light, and they now open in Neo Dark.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] With `?theme=neo-theme-neo-dark`, each of the nine opens on `neo-theme-neo-dark`. With `?theme=neo-theme-neo-light`, each opens on `neo-theme-neo-light`. The body carries the same class.
- [ ] Without a request, each opens as the resolver's other callers do: in Neo Dark when the browser prefers dark, otherwise on `themes[0]`, as on `dev`.
- [ ] After a request opposite an example's default, its ThemeSwitcher's first switch changes the visible theme.
- [ ] No console or page error in any load.

## Out of Scope

- The 15 examples of #21951 and the six toggle examples of #21973.
- One engine default that applies the request at boot and replaces the per-example line. Today 35 `app.mjs` files on `dev` carry that line; #21953 adds 15 more and this ticket nine. The engine default waits for #21973, because the six toggles break once their viewport carries a theme.

## Avoided Traps

- Riding #21953: it is in its second review round after being narrowed, and new scope there would reopen the review.
- Riding #21973: its six toggles need per-toggle work and browser specs after the cut. These nine need none of that.
